Note regarding requests:

Due to the recent increase in requests, I’m making this clear.

I only upload content I personally like. I’m not interested in spending my own money on artists I don’t care about. If you want me to upload something specific, cover the subscription cost. Otherwise, don’t ask.

If you repeatedly ask me to upload the same artist, I will blacklist that artist and never upload their content here.

The fee to remove an artist from the blacklist is 50 million credits.

I will update the blacklist on future posts.
